newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks rise almost 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks rise almost 100 points.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

* Toronto's key index soared 1.6 percent to close above the 6100 point level, as fears of U.S. interest rate hike waned.
* 109 million shares traded worth C$2.2 billion.
Toronto's key stock index rocketed almost 100 points higher on Friday as earnings euphoria rose and fears of a U.S. interest rate hike waned.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index climbed 97.01 points to 6106.91 and extended its winning streak to a fourth day.
Trading totaled 108.7 million shares worth C$2.16 billion.
"All of a sudden people are coming back to rational expectations," said Calgary-based portfolio manager Josef Schachter. "Earnings have been fantastic."
Stock market gains in Toronto and New York were fueled by news of a long-awaited agreement between the White House and congressional Republican leaders to balance the U.S. budget.
There were also growing expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve would not hike interest rates at its May 20 meeting since this week's U.S. economic data pointed to minimal inflation growth.
Of Toronto's 14 sub-indices, 12 rose, including media, utilities, consumer products and banks. Real estate and gold groups slipped.
Advancing issues led decliners 616 to 358, while 254 were unchanged.
--- HOT STOCKS ---

* Telecommunications conglomerate BCE Inc jumped 4.20 to 69.95. Cable and telephone companies were active after the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission on Thursday threw the country's local telephone market open to competition. It also came out in favor of convergence between the phone and cable television broadcast industries.
* Bank of Montreal jumped 1.70 to 53.75, leading interest-sensitive banks.
